name: FHIR Format Marketplace
summary: A single-skill Claude Code marketplace providing accuracy-first FHIR R4/R4B/R5 structure, terminology, and integration guidance.
description: A small Claude Code marketplace (FHIR Toolkit) wrapping one skill plugin, fhir-format, that provides accuracy-first guidance on HL7 FHIR (Fast Healthcare Interoperability Resources) R4, R4B, and R5 resource structure, terminology binding, and system integration. Catalogued here under this registry's bundle admission test (internal project documentation Phase 10): not itself a GA4GH-sponsored project, and deliberately marginal rather than a clean fit -- it is the thinnest of the marketplaces considered alongside biostat-agent and encode-toolkit (a single plugin wrapped in a marketplace manifest, closer in spirit to an individual plugin submission than a curated collection), but FHIR is a real, named, GA4GH-adjacent clinical-data-exchange standard (the plugin's own keywords are fhir, hl7, healthcare, interoperability), which is a concrete relevance fact rather than vague health-adjacent branding. Included at the explicit direction of the person running the session, who chose to treat the bundle admission bar as tolerant of this single-plugin marketplace shape. Terms check: the repository carries a real root LICENSE.md file (MIT, confirmed by direct fetch), and the plugin's own manifest entry independently declares "license": "MIT" too, so the two agree. No collision with this registry's own seeded plugin entries (all ga4gh-* slugs), so ga4gh.members is empty.
